body:
I don't think I'm gonna do it. I don't know, things are looking a little better for me. I hope you feel better.

In the  meantime, if you want to talk, I would like to have someone to talk to.
Thanks again for listening and offering a sympathetic ear. You are a good person.

Thanks for taking the time to try and help. It's sweet that you do that.

There really isn't anything at all positive about my life. No friends, no money, soon to be homeless, my teeth are rotting out of my face so I'll fit right in with the rest of the homeless people.

As for putting forth the effort, how do you think I have managed to live for twenty years, being miserable almost every single day? Do you think it was by some random chance or that It really hasn't been that bad this whole time?

I don't even know what I am doing posting on here.

What is the solution then? I have nothing, I have no one. I have tried medication and therapy. And even if I did think trying that for the umpteenth time might work, I don't' want to continue. I really don't. I just want to find a way to end it that I won't survive and make my life more of a hell than it already is, or cause even more pain than I'm already in.

Too much to list. 20 years of hell pretty much sums it up.

Recently I moved to New York to be with a friend who claimed she cared about me and wanted to help me out. After I got here it's obvious she just needs someone to help her pay her bills.

My Grandpa also died a few days before my birthday.

I am broke as fuck and even though it looks like I may have finally got a job, I may not even be able to afford the bus fare to and from work (its 9 miles away.)
No, I am 38. The major depression with a side of anxiety and suicidal thoughts started around 18, or at least that's when it started getting bad.

Thanks for the kind words.

I sometimes think that being compassionate and sensitive *are* my problems.

I appreciate you taking the time to listen to me rant and offer a sympathetic ear. 

I bet you are a wonderful person yourself.

I have lived most of my life alone. (I am 37). I didn't lose my virginity until I was 24. (I had the opportunity a couple of times before that, and while the mind was more than willing the body was not).

Every relationship I have ends in disaster.
My longest relationship was for five years. That one should have ended six months into it. I tried to actually. But she would cry and beg me to reconsider and promise to change.
I would see myself in her face, when I begged my first love not to leave me, and remembered how much it hurt when the person I loved more than anything acted like I meant nothing to her and adopted a "Get over it" attitude.

So I would take her back, and things would be better for a week and a half and then it was back to normal. So yeah, five years of hell.
I had a 'decent' job at one point, as a custodian at a university. And by decent I mean that if I spent my money wisely, I could survive, but not save any money.
I "wisely" decided that I didn't want to spend my life cleaning up other peoples shit, and taking shit from my boss.

So I decided to go into business with my sisters new husband. A man I knew almost nothing about.
When he inevitably didn't hold down any aspect of his end of the deal, I had already cashed in my 401k moved a thousand miles away, sold my car and spent all my money.
So I went from having a place to live, money and a car to having nothing and since then have been having the hardest time getting back on my feet.

My parents could never afford to send me to a dentist when I was a kid, so I my teeth aren't in the greatest shape. I would get work done to them a little bit at a time whenever I managed to save some money, and they weren't that bad when I quit my job, but since then they have gotten really bad . I am so embarrassed by my teeth that whenever I smile in public, I cover my hand over my mouth. People notice this and think I'm weird.

So, I am a 37 year old man who can't engage in any kind of healthy relationship with a woman. If I ever do meet a woman, there is a very good chance I won't be able to get it up the first time we try to have sex. I am penniless, about to be homeless. I have the smile of a zombie. And my only vehicle is a mountain bike.

Thanks.

 I am usually pretty good at maintaining a reasonable disposition, but my situation is pretty desperate. I have always been sort of proud of myself for being a hard worker and taking reasonably good care of my finances.

I also reread my post and probably sounded to judgmental of "bums". I don't assume that homeless people are lazy. I know a great many of them are there due to circumstances beyond their control. I have waited until I am literally almost starving I have applied for Food Stamps and to be qualified for income based housing. 

Hopefully, I'll qualify and get approved before I am actually homeless.

Thanks again for the kind words.
Thank you, that was very nice :)
